name: Archer Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank on the floor with your hands set very wide and fingers turned slightly outward.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a rigid straight line from head to heels.
Shift your chest toward one hand and bend that elbow to lower down while keeping your opposite arm straight.
Press powerfully back up to center, then lower toward the opposite hand, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Move your shoulders and hips together as one unit without sagging your lower back.
Keep the assisting hand planted steadily rather than rolling onto the outer edge of your wrist.
